qualification: Serial virtualizer diagnostics without UART service calls

tests.scope: Production x86 serial_virt service compilation and link, not target execution
Full Spark gate including ARM guest console traffic and serial_virt readiness/input/output messages through the log drain
Target serial queue fragmentation, invalid-line recovery, 128 exact reports after backpressure and public CLI comparison

limitations: Runtime evidence is ARM-only. The x86 topology still does not instantiate serial_virt.
The generic logger's existing debug fallback remains on builds without log rings; no x86 physical console or device I/O claim is made.
